title: Polished Slabs Fix
description: Makes polished slabs consistent with smooth stone slabs
body:
Vanilla Tweaks provides a similar resource pack as this one. I only learned about it after publishing this. Because of this, I am archiving this project. The Vanilla Tweaks pack can be found here [Double Slab Fix](https://vanillatweaks.net/share#9oTshG)

Makes polished andesite, blackstone, deepslate, diorite, granite, and tuff slabs consistent with smooth stone slabs.

<details>
<summary>Permissions</summary>
  
You may:
- Create and publish modified versions
- Include modified versions of this within your own resource packs
- Include this in modpacks published to Modrinth

You may not:
- Reupload or redistribute this pack or any assets from this page in ANY form
  
</details>

<details>
<summary>About Updates</summary>

I usually only test pack updates on the latest version of Minecraft. Resource packs are almost always backwards and forwards compatible. If you experience any issues or if the pack doesn't work, please report it to me.

</details>
